{"task": {"id": "I_kwDOVQjdzc8AAAABae4X-w", "item_id": "PVTI_lAHOAHSLSM4Bn3IVzhEFRP8", "project_id": "PVT_kwHOAHSLSM4Bn3IV", "number": 67, "title": "Honor SCSP synthesis pipeline latency before mixer and DSP publication", "body": "## Problem

Related to #17.

At main `03b6a0580b19cabcf68b92994d06c1d0b6865311`, SCSP waveform acquisition has separately retained DRAM operands, but synthesis-to-mixer publication still collapses the documented slot pipeline:

- `src/sound/pcm.rs::begin_slot` calculates envelope state, modulation and waveform addresses together.
- `sample_cycle` calls `end_slot` within the same four-memory-cycle slot interval. `end_slot` immediately updates the direct mix and DSP MIXS inputs.
- `src/sound/synthesis.rs::Stack` separately delays sound-stack publication. Its existing five-slot tests therefore do not establish correct mixer/DSP producer timing.
- `begin_sample` handles an idle generator by advancing all slots together and fixes `pcm_clocked` for the sample, leaving idle-to-active scheduling dependent on that shortcut.

These shortcuts matter when an executing effects program consumes a voice around its production boundary, and when late-slot work crosses the sample boundary. Existing steady-state stereo tests cannot establish that ordering.

## Expected outcome

Implement the documented synthesis pipeline's observable timing, retaining in-flight slot results until their appropriate consumers can receive them. Preserve correct waveform acquisition, modulation generations and shared-memory arbitration.

The primary contract is [SCSP User's Manual ST-077-R2](https://antime.kapsi.fi/sega/files/ST-077-R2-052594.pdf), §4.2, printed pp.56–57, Figures 4.30–4.31: PG/PLFO at OP1, address/modulation work at OP2, waveform acquisition at OP3, interpolation/EG/ALFO at OP4, level calculation at OP5–OP6 and sound-stack publication at OP7. OP1-to-OP7 spans six slot intervals; OP2-to-OP7 spans five. The later [SCSP manual's pipeline description](https://www.infochunk.com/saturn/segahtml_en/hard/scsp/hon/p04_fm2.htm), Figures 4.24–4.25, confirms this relationship.

Reconcile this pipeline with ST-077 §3.2/Figure 3.2's 128 DRAM cycles per sample, §4.2's IMXL/ISEL routing, and §5/Figure 5.1's effects inputs. Establish the mixer/DSP publication contract from affirmative primary evidence rather than assuming it equals the existing stack delay. Separate documented relative ordering from unspecified absolute interface phases and equal-edge conventions.

Scope is synthesis pipeline timing, consumer publication, sample wrap and the scheduler changes necessary for those behaviors. Numeric envelope-rate calibration, noise-polynomial accuracy, unrelated DSP instructions and physical pin timing remain outside this increment and remain required where applicable under #17.

## Context and reproduction

Code inspection establishes the collapsed execution path; this planning pass did not rerun implementation acceptance suites.

Relevant implementation and tests:

- `src/sound/pcm.rs:33`, `:176`, `:239`: slot calculation, immediate mix/MIXS publication and four-cycle dispatch.
- `src/sound/synthesis.rs:169`: retained stack publication and current/past generations.
- `src/sound.rs:392`, `Sound::scsp_deadline`: sample-wide activity selection and idle scheduling.
- `src/sound/pcm/tests.rs::two_operand_reads_retain_separate_data_and_publish_only_after_interpolation`: currently expects direct mixing immediately after the two waveform reads.
- `src/sound/synthesis/tests.rs::modulation_uses_recent_or_past_generation_after_five_slot_pipeline_clocks`: preserve its independently derived generation rules.
- `src/sound/dsp/clock_tests.rs`, `tests/scsp_clock.rs`, `tests/scsp_pcm.rs`, `tests/synthesis.rs`: existing effects, waveform, arbitration and guest evidence.

Reproduce the gap with an independently authored deadline vector: produce a distinctive PCM value, execute DSP reads around the source-derived mixer-input publication boundary, and inspect retained results before and after publication. Include a late slot whose processing crosses the sample boundary. Expected values and deadlines must be derived before changing production behavior.

Upstream main matches the inspected revision. The open-Issue search returned no duplicates. The observed current-main CI snapshot has Wasm successful and native/browser jobs in progress; pending jobs establish neither failure nor success. The latest validation record reports complete local checks, but those results do not establish pipeline completeness.

## Pre-merge acceptance criteria

- [ ] Document a primary-derived stage/consumer table identifying slot identity, relative deadlines, retained operands, waveform-read phases, stack generations, mixer/DSP publication and sample-boundary ownership. Reconcile applicable corrections. Explicitly label unspecified phase conventions; do not invent register-latch semantics from a diagram alone.
- [ ] Implement bounded retained pipeline work across slots 31→0 and sample boundaries. Mixer/DSP consumers cannot observe a result before its required level calculation completes. Preserve the documented OP2-to-OP7 stack relationship without adding a second artificial delay.
- [ ] Add independent native deadline vectors for slots 0, a middle slot and 31, both PCM widths, signed interpolation, direct and effects sends, and simultaneous voices. Assert unchanged early consumer values, exact published arithmetic, once-only contributions and retained operands after later waveform changes.
- [ ] Exercise current/past FM generations, source/carrier distances on both sides of the five-slot boundary, wraparound and STWINH. Preserve all existing selector/generation coverage and distinguish actual scheduled execution from helper-only tests.
- [ ] Verify idle-to-active and active-to-idle transitions at multiple sample phases. Skipping idle work must preserve observable slot timing, LFO/stack progression and later activation. Test reset cancellation of in-flight synthesis without stale stack, MIXS or audio publication; preserve existing sound-CPU versus SCSP reset domains.
- [ ] Preserve separate PCM operand grants/completions and PCM/DSP/refresh/DMA/CPU ownership. Compare records, publication boundaries and stereo output across advancement chunks 1/3/17/10000, with and without passive inspection.
- [ ] Add an original MIT-licensed synthetic guest with reproducible source, builder and hashes. Actual SH-2/68k instructions configure voices and upload an executing SCSP DSP program that probes early/late input availability and computes distinguishing RAM/audio results. Include changed operands, omitted voice/send controls, sample-wrap coverage and repeated cold boots. Demonstrate that the unchanged independent oracle rejects the inherited premature-publication path.
- [ ] Run identical guest bytes and authored expectations in native Machine and rebuilt production Wasm under `/saturn-rust/`. Assert guest records and deterministic stereo buffers; verify delivery through the production AudioWorklet with blocked/underflow/drop states remaining observable. Register reproduction and browser checks in the existing required workflow.
- [ ] Preserve existing tests and all three demonstrations, including gameplay/results/restart, dual CPUs, DMA/IRQs, CD-DA, backup and both input ports. Correct an inherited timing oracle only with an explicit primary-derived rationale, retaining its substantive arithmetic, waveform, ownership and mutation assertions.
- [ ] Pass `cargo fmt --check`, `cargo build --locked`, `cargo test --locked`, native all-target and Wasm Clippy with `-D warnings`, `sh scripts/check-fixtures.sh`, `sh scripts/build-web.sh`, complete `npm run test:browser`, browser-runner tests and `git diff --check`, without required skips.
- [ ] Update architecture, conformance and validation records with exact references, implementation/test links, actual results and remaining deviations. If primary evidence corrects an AI-authored criterion, update this Issue with the reference and rationale; no human-confirmation gate is required. Report this as partial #17 progress, retain its unmet umbrella scope and use no closing reference to #17.

## Optional validation

Additional source-authored FM chains and effects-routing stress cases are useful. Personal firmware, commercial media, physical-console comparison, human listening and live Pages inspection are not required.

## Required post-merge verification

None.
